## Mock Store API
Fake order database for the demo (30 orders, fictional customers, example.com emails).

`GET /webhook/store/orders?order_number=DS-1001&email=...`

Returns `{ by_number, by_email }`. Swap for the Shopify Admin API in production.

parameters.jsCode:
// Mock store API: returns orders by order number and by customer email.
// GENERATED by scripts/build-workflows.js from src/. Edit the source files, then rebuild.

// In production, replace this workflow with an HTTP call to the Shopify Admin API (orders query by name / email).
function normalizeOrderNumber(raw) {
  if (raw === null || raw === undefined) return null;
  const m = String(raw).match(/(\d{4,6})/);
  return m ? 'DS-' + m[1] : null;
}

function findOrders(orders, query) {
  const num = normalizeOrderNumber(query && query.order_number);
  const email = String((query && query.email) || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return {
    by_number: num ? (orders.find(o => o.order_number === num) || null) : null,
    by_email: email ? orders.filter(o => o.email.toLowerCase() === email) : [],
  };
}
